scripts.emulators: node scripts/render-rules.mjs && PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH firebase emulators:start --project demo-premium-watch --import emulator-data --export-on-exit emulator-data
scripts.seed:dev: METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION=none FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=demo-premium-watch MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER=fake npm run seed -w @pw/job -- --demo
scripts.job:dev: METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION=none FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=demo-premium-watch MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER=fake npm start -w @pw/job --
scripts.backfill:dev: METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION=none FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9099 GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=demo-premium-watch MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER=fake npm run backfill -w @pw/job --
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n emu,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run emulators" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev -w @pw/web"

scripts.job:run: node scripts/with-deploy-env.mjs bash -c 'gcloud run jobs execute premium-watch-job --project=$PROJECT_ID --region=$REGION --wait'
